summary: I inspected 15 representative files across multiple subdirectories (MPS/Irreducible, MPS/Preparation, MPS/Symmetry, MPS/SharedInfra, MPS/Core, MPS/MPDO) from the 480 files in this work unit. Every file contains formal mathematical content: definitions (def), theorems (theorem), lemmas (lemma), and proofs with mathematical documentation citing specific papers (arXiv references, equation numbers, line numbers). The files develop tensor network mathematics including matrix product states (MPS), matrix product operators (MPO), canonical forms, gauge structure, quantum circuit preparation, symmetry classification, Wielandt theory, and the Fundamental Theorem of MPS. No file is a pure import aggregator, test file, or documentation-only file. All files contain executable Lean 4 formal mathematics relevant to search.
